title: pouteria hondurensis
intro: Pouteria hondurensis, commonly known as Honduran cherry, is a plant species native to Central America and Mexico. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to provide various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in the treatment of wounds and infections. The therapeutic actions of Honduran cherry include antioxidant and anti-cancer activities, as well as its ability to modulate the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
